name: Frigade's Yogurt Runs Private Meeting Transcription Entirely on Your Laptop
title: Frigade's Yogurt Runs Private Meeting Transcription Entirely on Your Laptop
summary: Frigade's new open source desktop app records meetings locally, transcribes with Whisper, and summarizes using llama.cpp, so audio never leaves your machine.
